title: Older pilots' private UFO stories

tellings.quote: guys, you know, kind of older guys been flying for a while, like they all just seem to have that cool story they tell you, you know, once they had a few drinks in them. [laughter]

plain: Ryan Graves, a US Navy fighter pilot who later spoke publicly about strange objects seen by his squadron, says that before he spoke out, older pilots who had been flying a long time all seemed to have a cool story of their own. According to Graves, they would only tell it once they had a few drinks in them, which suggests such sightings were common but kept private.
